title: 廚房
author: 吉本芭娜娜
description: 透過失去親人的年輕人與新建立的家人關係，描寫日常飲食、陪伴與悲傷中的重新生活。

en.title: Kitchen
en.author: Banana Yoshimoto
en.description: Through young people grieving lost relatives and forming new family bonds, these stories explore food, companionship, and finding a way to live after loss.

coverSource: Cover image supplied by Zhilin Ou.

title: 朗夜
author: 崔恩榮
description: 透過一名女子與外婆的重逢，小說串起四代女性在歷史變動中的生活、傷痛與相互扶持。

en.title: Bright Night
en.author: Choi Eunyoung
en.description: A woman's reunion with her grandmother traces four generations of women through historical upheaval, shared wounds, and mutual support.

title: 祥子的微笑
author: 崔恩榮
description: 七篇小說透過友誼、親情與離別，描寫個人關係如何承受歷史與社會的重量。
coverSource: Cover image supplied by Zhilin Ou.

en.title: Shoko’s Smile
en.author: Choi Eunyoung
en.description: Seven stories of friendship, family, and parting explore how personal relationships bear the weight of history and society.

title: 平面國
author: 愛德溫・A・艾勃特
description: 一個正方形在接觸三維世界後重新理解自身的二維社會，故事藉幾何想像探問認知、階級與偏見。

en.title: Flatland
en.author: Edwin A. Abbott
en.description: A square's encounter with a three-dimensional world transforms his understanding of his own society, using geometry to question perception, class, and prejudice.

title: 動物農莊
author: 喬治・歐威爾
description: 農場動物推翻人類統治後建立新秩序，卻逐漸落入另一套權力與特權之中。

en.title: Animal Farm
en.author: George Orwell
en.description: After overthrowing their human rulers, farm animals establish a new order that gradually reproduces the power and privilege they sought to escape.

title: 白
author: 韓江
description: 從白色事物展開的六十五則片段，圍繞早夭的姊姊，凝視記憶、哀傷與生命的延續。
coverSource: Cover image supplied by Zhilin Ou.

en.title: The White Book
en.author: Han Kang
en.description: Sixty-five fragments drawn from white things center on an elder sister who died in infancy, reflecting on memory, grief, and the continuation of life.

title: 少年來了
author: 韓江
description: 以光州事件為背景，交織少年、倖存者與家屬的聲音，追問暴力之後如何記憶與生活。
coverSource: Cover image supplied by Zhilin Ou.

en.title: Human Acts
en.author: Han Kang
en.description: Set around the Gwangju Uprising, the novel brings together the voices of a boy, survivors, and bereaved families to ask how people remember and live after violence.

title: 素食者
author: 韓江
description: 英惠決定不再吃肉，這個選擇引發家人的衝突與控制，小說透過三種視角探討身體自主、暴力與疏離。

en.title: The Vegetarian
en.author: Han Kang
en.description: Yeong-hye’s decision to stop eating meat provokes conflict and control within her family, as three perspectives explore bodily autonomy, violence, and alienation.

title: 白色畫像
author: 賴香吟
description: 三位平凡人物的生命故事，描繪戰後臺灣戒嚴生活中無所不在的恐懼、妥協與記憶。
coverSource: Cover image supplied by Zhilin Ou.

en.title: Portraits in White
en.author: Kaori Lai
en.description: The lives of three ordinary people reveal the fear, compromise, and memory woven into everyday life under martial law in postwar Taiwan.

title: 文青之死
author: 賴香吟
description: 這部短篇小說集書寫愛情、疾病與理想的變化，以及人們在時間中面對的失落。
coverSource: Cover image supplied by Zhilin Ou.

en.title: The Death of a Literary Youth
en.author: Kaori Lai
en.description: This short-story collection explores love, illness, changing ideals, and the losses people face as time passes.

title: 島
author: 賴香吟
description: 這部跨越三十年創作的小說集，從日常生活與個人記憶映照臺灣解嚴前後的社會變化與世代經驗。

en.title: Island
en.author: Kaori Lai
en.description: Spanning thirty years of writing, this story collection traces Taiwan’s social changes and generational experiences around the end of martial law through everyday life and personal memory.

coverSource: Cover image supplied by Zhilin Ou.

title: 其後
author: 賴香吟
description: 敘事者在友人離世後回望青春、友情與書寫，探索記憶留下的傷痛，以及倖存者如何繼續生活。

en.title: Afterwards
en.author: Kaori Lai
en.description: After a friend’s death, the narrator revisits youth, friendship, and writing, exploring the wounds of memory and how those left behind continue living.

coverSource: Cover image supplied by Zhilin Ou.

title: 如果我們無法以光速前進
author: 金草葉
description: 七篇科幻故事透過太空旅行、外星接觸與數位記憶，探問科技進步之中仍存在的孤獨、差異與相互理解。

en.title: If We Cannot Go at the Speed of Light
en.author: Kim Choyeop
en.description: Seven science-fiction stories use space travel, alien encounters, and digital memory to explore loneliness, difference, and mutual understanding amid technological progress.

coverSource: Cover image supplied by Zhilin Ou.

title: 進烤箱的好日子
author: 李佳穎
description: 一位寫作者轉而書寫回憶錄，在與家人和舊同學核對往事的過程中，追問成長記憶、事實與虛構之間的界線。

en.title: A Perfect Day to Put Your Head in the Oven
en.author: Lee Chia-Ying
en.description: Turning to memoir, a writer compares recollections with family and former classmates, questioning the boundaries between childhood memory, fact, and fiction.

coverSource: Flat front cover from the official Readmoo product listing https://readmoo.com/book/210337485000101 ; image https://cdn.readmoo.com/cover/mz/gpoitzm.jpg?v=1751245900 . Original cover artwork preserved without cropping; resized to 700 pixels high and encoded as WebP.

title: 臺北人
author: 白先勇
description: 小說描寫遷居臺北的人物，在故鄉記憶與現實生活之間呈現時代流轉與人生失落。
coverSource: Cover image supplied by Zhilin Ou.

en.title: Taipei People
en.author: Pai Hsien-yung
en.description: Stories of people who have moved to Taipei explore historical change and personal loss through the tension between memories of home and everyday life.

editionNote: User-provided cover; edition unconfirmed. Source link identifies the literary work.

title: 鱷魚手記
author: 邱妙津
description: 以私密手記與鱷魚寓言交錯敘事，描寫女大學生在愛情、人際關係與自我認同中的摸索。
coverSource: Cover image supplied by Zhilin Ou.

en.title: Notes of a Crocodile
en.author: Qiu Miaojin
en.description: Interweaving intimate diary entries with crocodile fables, the novel follows a young woman’s search for love, connection, and identity during her university years.

title: 蒙馬特遺書
author: 邱妙津
description: 以書信形式展開異鄉中的情感告白，探索愛情失落、創作與生命意義之間的糾葛。
coverSource: Cover image supplied by Zhilin Ou.

en.title: Last Words from Montmartre
en.author: Qiu Miaojin
en.description: Through letters written abroad, the novel explores the ties between lost love, artistic creation, and the search for meaning.

title: 我的骨頭知曉一切
author: 史蒂芬妮・胡
description: 史蒂芬妮・胡從自身經歷出發，追溯童年創傷的長期影響，記錄理解複雜性創傷與尋求修復的過程。
coverSource: Cover image supplied by Zhilin Ou.

en.title: What My Bones Know
en.author: Stephanie Foo
en.description: Drawing on her own experiences, Stephanie Foo traces the lasting effects of childhood trauma and her efforts to understand complex trauma and find healing.
